fact: The Programme d'Action du Gouvernement project sheet lists the high and very high speed internet deployment (phase 2) as a government project, status 'En cours', execution period 2022-2026, to bring broadband to the whole national territory, with an expected backbone capacity extension at 8 sites from 40 to 100 Gbps; the sheet carries no date, so 2022 is the start of the stated period.
system: Déploiement de l'Internet Haut et Très Haut Débit sur l'ensemble du territoire national (phase 2)

fact: Agence Ecofin reports that the minister of digital affairs said on 21 November 2024 the government plans to connect 18 more communes to fibre by mid-2025 to extend broadband to all 77 communes, as part of the broadband deployment project of the Programme d'action du gouvernement 2021-2026, costed at about 207 billion FCFA.
system: Déploiement de l'Internet haut et très haut débit sur l'ensemble du territoire national
